column1: # Nightly t2 bench baselines (ADR 0080), recorded on GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runners (4 vCPUs, 4 sim workers): tick p50 per
# scenario and runner CPU model (the median over the recording runs; the slowest run for models seen fewer than three
# times), and the calibration-normalized p50. tools/ci/check-bench.sh prints the row of every run.
# B3 has no row: its p50 is dominated by idle ticks (30% spread on one CPU model); B3 is gated by its planning check.
